The GPU-resident architecture is fully implemented and validated OFFLINE (Phases 36F/36G) and in a dedicated LIVE validation harness (Phase 36H). This is an ARCHITECTURAL_INTEGRATION_DEFECT but not a production runtime defect - the GPU path exists and works. The ~7.5 FPS in production live is due to using the CPU path, not a failure of the GPU architecture.
